usageDashboard.explanation: Total tokens includes uncached input, output, cache writes, and cache reads. Costs use current configured model prices, not historical invoices. Unpriced rows show — rather than zero. Run rates use the actual elapsed window; daily buckets and Today use UTC.
usageDashboard.asOf: Window ends {{date}}. Aggregates may be cached for up to one minute.
usageDashboard.loadError: Usage or weekly limits could not be loaded. Refresh to retry; missing results are not zero usage.
usageDashboard.unpriced: Pricing or token details are missing for {{count}} requests. The cost card shows only the priced subtotal; affected rows and run rates show —.
usageDashboard.startsOnRequest: Week starts on the first request
usageDashboard.capEditNote: Changes apply within about a minute and do not reset spend. Zero blocks new requests; Unlimited removes the cap.
usageDashboard.saveError: Could not save the cap. Check the amount and try again.
usageDashboard.budgetExplanation: Model API keys use the server-configured allowance, with no limit unless one is set. Each seven-day window starts on the first request. Estimated spend is checked before new requests; requests already running may finish. Cap changes and displayed spend can take about a minute to update. During accounting outages, local estimates allow continued service and extra spend may occur. Budget spend is separate from the selected history window.
usageDashboard.portalDescription: Monitor API spending, manage weekly allowances, and investigate usage.
usageDashboard.budgetDefault: Default: {{cap}} per key / 7 days. Each key has its own reset schedule.
usageDashboard.budgetReadError: Budget data could not be refreshed. Any displayed values are from the last successful read; editing is paused until refresh succeeds.
usageDashboard.labelsError: Key labels could not be loaded. Available budgets are still shown by fingerprint.
usageDashboard.truncatedBudgets: Only the first 10,000 policies are shown. This is an incomplete view; totals and exports cover displayed keys only.
usageDashboard.snapshotCoverage: Saved snapshots for {{count}} of {{total}} known keys
usageDashboard.attentionNote: At 80%+, at the cap, or blocked by budget
usageDashboard.snapshotNote: Active budget windows without a saved snapshot
usageDashboard.sort.name: Name
usageDashboard.noCap: Spend is tracked without a cap
usageDashboard.noKnownKeys: No known keys yet. Keys appear when labelled or when budget accounting starts.
usageDashboard.snapshotCaveat: Spend is the last saved estimate for each key’s current budget window. A missing snapshot is unknown, not zero. Snapshots update with activity; an old timestamp alone does not prove an outage. These totals are independent of the history date filter and are not a single calendar week.
usageDashboard.revocationNote: Budget status does not report API gateway suspensions. Changing a cap cannot reactivate a revoked credential. Accounting outages can allow additional spend; this screen is not a live Redis health monitor.
usageDashboard.capSaved: Cap saved. Enforcement can take about a minute to catch up.
usageDashboard.selectedWindow: Based on the selected history window

colleagues.intro: Assign work to AI assistants and follow their progress.
colleagues.emptyText: Start with a researcher, an editor, or a role of your own. Every assistant can use your files, workspace, skills, and connected tools.
colleagues.researchInstructions: Research questions carefully, check primary sources, and keep a concise record of evidence and uncertainty. Ask for help when a decision needs my input.
colleagues.editorInstructions: Help me shape clear, accurate writing. Preserve the author’s voice and flag factual gaps before changing the meaning.
colleagues.analystInstructions: Analyze data with reproducible calculations. Check assumptions, explain the results, and save the working files so I can inspect them.
